title: RunBrief
description: The plain-language run brief the orchestrator states before invoking any specialist, persisted so surfaces other than the conversation can show it. Fields mirror the seven questions in the guided-mode run brief (SKILL.md) and templates/user-checkpoint.md. Written once at SOURCE_ACCEPTED and updated only when scope is corrected; it records intent, never results — counts live in the artifacts themselves.

why.description: The decision this run clarifies, in the user's terms.

what.description: The immediate output and the final deliverables.

who.description: Who supplies inputs, who decides, and who reviews or issues.

where.description: Accepted source set, the durable run directory, and any external systems.

run_kind.description: A source with no issuance goal is a diagnostic run: no certificate is implied and the outcome focus stays provisional.

outcome_focus.description: The outcome the run is about. Provisional until the user confirms it.

sources.description: Accepted sources, named as the user would recognise them.

exclusions.description: What this run deliberately does not cover, so scope creep is visible.
